name: La Fata Ignorante - Rooftop Restaurant & Bar
Ristorante Arlu
description: Those looking for a restaurant in St. Peter, in Arlu will find a pleasant and familiar atmosphere where you can taste lunches and dinners made with natural ingredients, with an excellent balance between quality and price. From over fifty years we welcome tourists and lovers of good food in an unpretentious atmosphere, furnished with style and elegance. In the kitchen we favor seasonal raw materials and this guarantees freshness and digestibility to our dishes, from meat to fish passing through appetizers and desserts. Maximum attention is paid to the preparation of homemade biscuits, bread, cakes and pasta. To all this is added the kindness of a harmonious staff, composed of the members of a family that for a generarions has been handed down the craft of the restaurateur. Traditional cuisine and Mediterranean atmosphere, but also warmth and affection worthy of the italian culture.

name: Ad Hoc Ristorante - Piazza del Popolo
description: On the romantic corner of Via di Ripetta, at the heart of the Eternal City, Ad Hoc restaurant in Rome is the ideal place to enjoy pleasant moments of relaxation complemented by the traditional tastes and ancient aromas of Roman and Mediterranean cuisine. An intimate dining destination for all seasons, you can expect a warm greeting at Ad Hoc restaurant in Rome before taking your seat to enjoy high quality cuisine, skilfully prepared with the freshest fish, meat and seasonal game. Truffle all the year with a dedicated menu. Chef Marco Casentini insists on taking no shortcuts with the quality of his ingredients, and the chef's passion for the light cuisine he prepares makes him confident that each dish is worth the wait. Ad Hoc restaurant is also proud of its wine cellar. Compiled from continuous and careful research into the best labels, the wine list showcases 800 wines .

description: Mi'Ndujo - via Catania, quartiere universitario (P.za Bologna) - sala interna e dehors. Possibilità di organizzare eventi e compleanni. Possibilità di asporto e presenti su Deliveroo. Mi'Ndujo è un Brand di ristorazione specializzato in panini di qualità, 100% Made in Calabria. 1° classificato "Migliori Panini d'Italia" 50 Top Italy 2025, segnalato nella Guida Street Food Gambero Rosso 2023, Consigliata da Accademia del Panino Italiano. Il nostro segreto? Pane caldo e fragrante, fatto in casa seguendo una ricetta della tradizione, con doppia lievitazione fino a 48h e infornato nel momento dell'ordine. Prodotti freschi e genuini per panini golosi e sani! La carne dei nostri panini proviene dai Monti della Sila, non contiene conservanti e additivi. Non c’è solo il piccante! Vogliamo farvi scoprire tutti i sapori della Calabria! Sosteniamo il territorio e i piccoli produttori, sosteniamo il rispetto dell'ambiente con una politica Plastic Free.
